observations.surface: artwork editor > Select a layer type modal
observations.observed_result: Entries: Static Image, Clipart Category, 'Photo Upload' (has submenu chevron), 'Text to Image (AI)' (standalone, NO 'Beta' badge/text anywhere in label), Dynamic Clipart by Text. 'Multiple Uploads' is NOT a top-level entry — it is a submenu item under 'Photo Upload' alongside 'Single Upload'.

Option Title (text) | Output Type: radio 'Single Output' (default, checked) / 'Multiple Outputs (coming soon)' (DISABLED) | Maximum photos* (spinbutton, required, default=3) | Upload editor: 'Direct upload, no editor' (default) / 'Photo Reposition' | GenAI service* (required select, default='Select a service' disabled-selected; options: Gemini, OpenAI, Flux, ImagenHub) | Image effects after generating (empty list + Add new) | Fit mode: Contain (default) / Fill | toggle 'Show customer's photo on live preview' (ON by default) | toggle 'Set minimum size' (OFF) | 'Add instruction for customer' textarea (placeholder: 'If you cannot upload photo, please try opening the link on Chrome or Safari browser.') | toggle 'Show customization data on cart/checkout' (OFF) | 'Custom class' text. NO 'Populate Values' accordion present on this layer (only 'Personalization Settings', 'Conditional Setting', 'Extra').

observations.surface: Multiple Uploads layer > GenAI service = Gemini
observations.observed_result: Selecting Gemini reveals: 'Prompt the result you want (Prompts won't work if they contain keywords prohibited by API providers. Learn more):' textarea, placeholder 'Turn these images into the style...', '+ Variable' button, hint 'Add variables to make the prompt change based on customer choices. Use the option title as the variable name, example: {{name}}', link 'Example Prompts'.

observations.surface: Multiple Uploads layer > GenAI service = ImagenHub
observations.observed_result: Instead of a prompt textarea, shows 'ImagenHub Template:' picker ('No template selected' + 'Select template' link), and a toggle 'Use Template Default Size' (OFF by default) directly below it — confirms this field is provider-conditional (ImagenHub only) as described in the brief.

observations.surface: artwork editor > Select a layer type modal > IMAGE column
observations.observed_result: No Beta badge next to 'Text to Image (AI)' in the layer-type picker, and no Beta badge in its Personalization Settings panel header either. Consistent across both surfaces.

observations.surface: Text to Image (AI) layer ('hair') > Personalization Settings
observations.observed_result: THREE options present: 'No personalization', 'Create a new option' (default/checked), 'Use an existing global option'. CONFLICTS with canon KB-019 claim ('chỉ có Create new option / Use existing global option, không có No personalization') — re-verified now on 2026-09-25 and 'No personalization' IS present.

observations.surface: Text to Image (AI) layer > GenAI service dropdown
observations.observed_result: Options exactly: 'Select a service' (disabled/selected default), '[Gemini] Text to image', '[OpenAI] Text to image', '[Flux] Text to image', '[ImagenHub] Text to image' — confirms '[Provider] Text to image' label pattern.

observations.surface: Text to Image (AI) layer > GenAI service = Flux
observations.observed_result: Selecting '[Flux] Text to image' shows a normal prompt textarea (placeholder 'Generate an image of...') plus note 'The generated image uses this layer's ratio.' NO warning/error message about Flux not supporting text-to-image was observed anywhere in the UI after selecting it. This CONTRADICTS the brief's expectation (from Jira TIB-5326 description) of a visible unsupported-provider warning. Only one sample/one attempt — do not generalize; a warning may only surface at actual generate-time (API-level), which was not exercised (see unknowns).

observations.surface: Text to Image (AI) layer > GenAI service = ImagenHub
observations.observed_result: Shows 'ImagenHub Template:' picker ('No template selected' + 'Select template') with note 'The ImagenHub template decides the output ratio, so it may not match this layer's ratio.' No 'Use Template Default Size' toggle here (that toggle was only observed on the Multiple Uploads layer, OBS-005) — a layer-type-specific difference.

observations.surface: Text to Image (AI) layer > '+ Variable' button (Gemini prompt)
observations.observed_result: Clicking '+ Variable' with no other Text/Additional Option layer present in the artwork shows an inline message: 'Add a Text or Additional Option layer to use variables in your prompt.' — clarifies the prompt-variable mechanism pulls from OTHER Text/Additional-Option layers' Option Titles (e.g. {{name}}), not a literal static '{{Layer name}}' token referencing the layer itself.

This plain photo layer has THREE accordions: 'Populate Values' (collapsed, listed FIRST), 'Personalization Settings', then (scrolled) 'Conditional Setting', 'Extra'. Confirms 'Populate Values' exists on ordinary photo/image-type layers but was absent on the two GenAI layers (OBS-003, and same checked on Text-to-Image — no Populate Values accordion there either).

observations.surface: destination layer 'body' > Populate Values (expanded) > toggle ON > Source option dropdown
observations.observed_result: Only 'top' (the Multiple Uploads layer) appears as a selectable Source option. 'hair' (the Text-to-Image layer, Option Title 'AI Hair Style') does NOT appear in this list — i.e. Text-to-Image layers were not offered as populate-content sources in this session, only Multiple Uploads was. Single sample; do not generalize to 'never' — flagged in unknowns.

observations.surface: destination layer 'body' > Populate Values > Source option='top' > 'Available Value' picker
observations.element: token list with exact tooltip text
observations.observed_result: Exactly 4 tokens offered, verbatim: '{{input.1}} - return the original photo #1 that buyers uploaded to this Multiple Uploads option, before effects. This layer's own effects will automatically run on it.' / same pattern for {{input.2}}, {{input.3}} (matches Maximum photos=3 on the source layer) / '{{output}} - return the generated image of this Multiple Uploads option, after its effects. Only available on the Single Output type.' NO plain unindexed '{{input}}' token was offered — only indexed {{input.N}} variants plus {{output}}. This is a first-party UI-text confirmation of TIB-5302's claimed mechanism (destination layer auto-runs its own effect on the populated pre-effect source image), captured as static config-level evidence — actual runtime trigger was NOT executed (see unknowns).
Selecting the {{input.1}} token inserts literal text '{{input.1}}' into the 'Values:' textbox for this layer's populate-content config.

observations.surface: artwork editor > Save & Close (before required prompt fields filled)
observations.observed_result: Verbatim red toast: 'Template - Default template: / top: - Prompt the result you want is required / hair: - Prompt the image you want is required'. Confirms prompt field is a required field per-layer when a GenAI service is selected, enforced at artwork-save time (client-side, before the POST /api/artworks call succeeds).

observations.surface: POST /api/artworks request/response body (after filling required prompts)
observations.observed_result: multiple-uploads layer: output_type='single', max_photos=3, multi_image_provider='gemini', multi_image_prompt=<text>. text-to-image layer: text_to_image_provider='gemini', form_label=<Option Title>, text_to_image_prompt=<text>. destination photo layer: retrieval_value_enabled=true, retrieval_layer='layer-703775' (id of source 'top' layer), retrieval_value='{{input.1}}'. Response echoes same schema plus server-assigned artwork id=4416, current_version_id=12291.

Portal shows a promotional banner: 'ARTWORK 2.0 — New layer types · Global options · Advanced "polulate values" & Link layers · Font, Color & Toggle as layers and many more' — corroborates (does not confirm details of) the CCR's premise that this GenAI/populate-values cluster is a recent, actively-promoted release.
